current_uncommitted_code_changes.summary: Adds playMixedGrassTouch(), routes manual, AOE, sprinkler, and companion grass-touch SFX through it, and ducks music only when AudioSystem actually plays a grass-touch sound.

Adds SFX compressor/limiter, lowers SFX master gain from 0.58 to 0.5, lowers grass-touch transient via TOUCH_TRANSIENT_GAIN = 0.76, and makes playGrassTouch() return whether a sound was allowed through the throttle.
Adds music compressor/limiter, lowers game/title master gain staging, adds duckForSfx(depth, releaseSeconds), and restores target gain after ducking.

uncommitted_audio_fix_details.problem_reported: The background music sounds clipped when clicking grass.
diagnosis: AudioSystem and ChiptuneMusicSystem each create their own Web Audio context and connect directly to context.destination.
Music master gain was hot: setVolume() used trackGain 1.18 for game tracks and 1.12 for title track.
Grass-touch SFX can create several simultaneous voices per click: noise brush, snap, low tone, high tone, optional trait ping, optional tier sparkle, optional crit accent.
Rapid clicks can stack SFX over already-loud chiptune output and cause device/browser output clipping.

changes: Added DynamicsCompressorNode limiter after SFX master.
Set TOUCH_TRANSIENT_GAIN = 0.76 to lower grass-click transient level while preserving shape.
playGrassTouch() now returns boolean to indicate whether the touch sound actually passed throttling and was scheduled.
Added DynamicsCompressorNode limiter after music master.
Replaced hot trackGain values with TITLE_MASTER_GAIN = 0.88 and GAME_MASTER_GAIN = 0.82.
Added duckForSfx(depth, releaseSeconds), which temporarily lowers music gain during grass-touch SFX and recovers smoothly.
duckForSfx avoids work when music is not playing or muted.
Manual touch, AOE touch, sprinkler touch, and animal companion touch now route through playMixedGrassTouch().
Music ducks only if AudioSystem.playGrassTouch() returns true, so throttled/skipped SFX do not pump the music.

first_adjustments: Lower GAME_MASTER_GAIN in ChiptuneMusicSystem.ts from 0.82 toward 0.76.
Lower TOUCH_TRANSIENT_GAIN in AudioSystem.ts from 0.76 toward 0.68.
Increase duck depth effect by changing normal duck depth in GameScene.ts from 0.86 toward 0.82, combo duck from 0.82 toward 0.78, or crit duck from 0.78 toward 0.72.

tuning_guide_if_not_right.symptom: Grass click feels too quiet or unsatisfying.
first_adjustments: Raise TOUCH_TRANSIENT_GAIN in AudioSystem.ts from 0.76 toward 0.84.
Do not remove the limiter unless absolutely necessary.

tuning_guide_if_not_right.symptom: Music feels like it pumps too much when clicking.
first_adjustments: Raise the normal duck depth in GameScene.ts from 0.86 toward 0.9.
Leave crit duck a bit stronger because crit SFX are louder.

uncommitted_audio_fix_details.future_audio_architecture_note: Ideal long-term fix would be a shared AudioContext/mixer with music and SFX buses feeding one master limiter. The current candidate is intentionally smaller and safer for tonight: separate context limiters plus gain staging and ducking.

highlights: No console warnings/errors after corrected local SVG MIME serving.
Store open hotspots stayed low: ui:store about 2.4ms, store:layout about 1.3ms, store:automation about 1.1ms.

from_AGENTS_md: Treat every-frame and every-tick work as suspicious until measured.
Do not refactor hot paths blindly.
Keep ordinary tap/regrow/automation updates from forcing board layout or common-layer redraws.
Avoid expensive graphics resource operations in normal gameplay.
On large fields, preserve viewport culling and dirty-tile overlays.
Saves should be queued/deferred during active layout, panning, or redraw work unless page is hiding/shutting down.
applies_to_audio: Audio change is not expected to affect frame performance because it adds a few persistent Web Audio nodes and a constant-time duck call only when a throttled SFX plays.
Do not add per-frame audio analysis or waveform metering unless explicitly profiling a sound issue.
If adding audio diagnostics, gate them behind ?perf or another debug flag.

recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.name: Prestige UX and pacing polish
recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.why: Prestige is now functional and live, but the next addictive step is making the reset decision and post-reset acceleration feel ceremonious and legible.
ideas: Add a prestige summary panel or stronger status line showing current run, memory gain, and next multiplier.
Add post-prestige early-run acceleration cues so players immediately feel the x2+ power.
Consider a first-prestige mini-celebration with minimal display object budget.
recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.performance_note: Use existing skill-tree overlay and status text; avoid always-on HUD churn.

recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.name: Bumpy progression goals
recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.why: NotebookLM research emphasized slow strategic walls followed by explosive breakthroughs.
ideas: More explicit next-breakthrough cards for automation, journal discoveries, and prestige.
Milestone ownership multipliers for all automation systems beyond current tiers.
Careful cost/production tuning so automation bursts are noticeable.
recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.performance_note: Keep calculations cached or inside existing refresh cadence.

recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.name: Dual limiter concept
recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.why: A second bottleneck can make automation choices more strategic than pure touch generation.
ideas: Prototype Hands Available or Carrying Capacity as a soft cap on automation conversion.
Could tie store/seed upgrades to expanding capacity.
Must not make early automation feel nerfed; introduce only after the player has enough systems.
recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.performance_note: Avoid per-tile resource scans; derive from owned systems/upgrades/stats.

recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.name: Collection completion hooks
recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.why: Journal bonuses are live, so the next step is making completion goals visible and juicy.
ideas: Add collection completion badges in Journal.
Add next undiscovered grass/weather/trait hint without spoiling too much.
Tie prestige memory bonus lightly to collection completion later if balance supports it.
recommended_next_design_chunks_after_aud.performance_note: Journal-only UI, refreshed at panel cadence.
